content.comment_body: Hello all, I'm working with a [product_name] to process analog data from a sensor. I'm using an AI block connected to a NAQ. My goal is to acquire data using Node-Red and the S7 protocol. The sensor's displayed value doesn't match the Node-Red value; for example, the temperature sensor shows 46.6, but Node-Red reads 307. I've tried reading INT and WORD formats from both VM and blocks at different addresses (DB1,INT1406 ; DB1,WORD1406 ; DB1,INT0; DB1,WORD0), but still get 307. I'm stuck—does anyone know what might be causing this?
What is the data format of the temperature sensor output?

I'm not certain of the format. The sensor is an IFM TN2435. The datasheet ([url]) doesn't specify the data format, and I'm unsure how to find the data type in [product_name]Soft. I just see the raw value as 46.6.
According to the sensor's datasheet, the temperature range is -50.0 to 150.0 °C. You need to scale the AI value to fit this range.

Thanks! Communication looks fine, but the [product_name] doesn't read the values correctly. I've replicated the block properties, but now [product_name] shows 75 while the actual reading is 19.7. Any idea why?
Which version of the sensor are you using? Is it a 4-20 mA output or a 0-10 V output? Which AI module are you using—on the base module or an AM2 module? And how is the wiring set up?
Just to clarify, does a sensor measurement of 46.6 correspond to a value of 466? Is that correct?
A new topic has been posted by [user_name] in a separate thread regarding reading data from Node-Red using DB1,WORD0. Best regards [user_name]
Yes, [product_name] only displays decimal points on its screen.
The output is 4-20mA. I'm using an AM2 module, and I've just rechecked the wiring—everything appears correct.
Please upload your project as a ZIP file.
Thank you for your help, [user_name]. Upon closer inspection, I found a wiring issue. Everything is functioning properly now!

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are facing challenges with analog data reading and scaling while connecting a [product_name] system to an external sensor and using Node-Red with the S7 protocol. The main issue is a mismatch between sensor readings and Node-Red values despite experimenting with data formats and addresses. Users are also unsure about correct data formats, scaling methods, and module setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy and reliable transfer of analog sensor values through [product_name] to Node-Red, with output readings precisely mirroring sensor measurements and minimal need for manual troubleshooting or configuration.
